by_document_anonymized.pattern: supported recall is low in every document (range 3/15 to 11/20); contradicted and unsupported recall are high except one document with 13/17 contradicted

by_hypothesis_length_chars.pattern: cases with hypothesis >= 100 chars (mostly supported) mismatch far more often than shorter hypotheses; supported hypotheses are systematically longer (median 125) than contradicted (82.5) and unsupported (67.5), so class and length/complexity are confounded

by_phenomenon_metadata.pattern: negation and numeric flags show no aggregate exact-match difference; coreference n=6 is too small; flags do not explain the recall gap

by_premise_length_chars.pattern: no strong premise-length gradient; all premises are 678-800 chars (chunk regime 800/120), far from single-sentence XNLI training

score_distribution_summaries_no_per_case.reading: supported cases score high on entailment in aggregate yet 62/100 fall below S=0.97 (37 weak + 25 unsupported); the long tail of low entailment on near-verbatim supported pairs and the high contradiction on novel-detail unsupported pairs point to model/premise-regime issues, not to a clean threshold cut

findings: primary candidate result stands: recall_supported 33/100 < preregistered 0.5, numeric_acceptance=false, false_support 1/196
raising S from 0.75 to 0.97 moves 32 supported verdicts to weak and removes 2 false supports in aggregate; contradiction and unsupported outcomes are identical between thresholds
supported recall is low in all six documents; contradicted (84/100) and unsupported (90/96) recall are comparatively high
hypothesis length is the strongest aggregate confounder: >=100 chars mismatches at 57/98 vs ~16% below 100 chars, and supported claims are systematically longer
negation/numeric metadata show no aggregate exact-match gap; coreference has only 6 cases
score medians separate classes in aggregate, but the tails overlap through the thresholds in both directions
limitations: AI-proposed labels, artificial data, no human review; not gold and not an acceptance test
296 cases share 100 chunks and 6 documents; observations are not independent; Wilson intervals are descriptive only
label classes differ systematically in hypothesis length/complexity (supported median 125 vs contradicted 82.5 vs unsupported 67.5); recall gaps are confounded with that construction choice
800-char premises are outside single-sentence XNLI training regime; chunking/windowing effects cannot be separated here
comparison of current thresholds on the same scores is descriptive; it does not authorize selection or configuration from this reserve
no production, capacity, latency, tenant-isolation, or phase-closure claim follows from this file
